description: This PHP file is part of the vtiger CRM system. It handles deletion of PriceBook records, including removing associated product relations, and redirects the user to a specified return URL after deletion.

classes.name: PriceBooks
classes.description: Model class representing PriceBooks in the CRM, used here to perform delete operations.
